projects.title: Gated Mixture-of-Experts Fusion for Multimodal Deepfake Detection
projects.supervisor: Agung Toto Wibowo, S.T., M.T., Ph.D.
projects._notes: Rifqi led the research and wrote the code; 2nd author. Aprilianza Muhammad Yusup is 1st author and presenter. Student mentor: Ahmad Taufiq Nur Rohman, S.Kom. Accepted at ICoDSA 2026, registration deadline 18 August 2026, IEEE indexing requires presentation. Numbers verified against the final manuscript: do not claim F1 0.94 or cross-dataset 0.60, those were never in the paper. Static concatenation slightly outperforms MoE on the combined split (0.9096 vs 0.9076); the contribution is interpretability and speed.
highlights: Built a Modality Reliability Gate that routes each 2-second segment to an audio or visual expert and reports which modality drove the verdict, a signal no compared method produces.
F1 0.9076, AUC 0.9744, AP 0.9948 across 223,445 segments from five datasets. Runs at 0.202 real-time factor on a 6GB laptop GPU. Accepted at ICoDSA 2026.
